dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, serrated light-colored perimeters forming interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. High-contrast transitions occur from the dark base pelage to the light-toned margins, which enclose dark internal cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters; small, elongated light flecks are concentrated in the anterior rostral region and lack internal dark gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle, with the longest side oriented toward the posterior-lateral edge of the visible frame.

other_distinctive_markers: A specific transition zone where high-density interlocking dorsal annuli give way to smaller, more isolated and elongated spots on the lateral snout area.
